what_this_is: Every placeholder the Stage-3 ADV-1 (S3-4) and CELL-1 (S3-6) fragments still carry, with the exact JSON path it lives at, the artefact that produces its value and the field to copy. Written when both packages were re-pointed from the 800-row construction roster R01 onto the 625-row clean subset R01C (coordinator decision 102, pending owner confirmation). Everything that a committed byte could fill was filled then; what is listed here is exactly what cannot exist until cell ROLL-1 seals (the S3-3 group), until ADV-1 seals and S3-5 releases (the S3-5/S3-6 group), or until root performs its own act (the root group). Nothing in this file authorises a flight, a readiness flip or an admission entry.

substitution_tool.semantics: Each token is replaced wherever it appears as a whole JSON string value. The default --occurrence-policy exactly-one is the ROLL-1 rule (a token must occur exactly once per named fragment); at-least-one is what the groups below need, because a release hash is pinned by several held cells of one experiment fragment. Whatever the policy, a token that occurs nowhere in the whole fragment set is refused. A value that still contains PENDING_ is refused. Fragments that carry a stage3_pending_placeholders block get the closed entries moved into stage3_placeholders_filled with the --by note; fragments that carry no such block are left structurally alone.

groups.blocked_by: Cell ROLL-1 (run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLLOUT-R01-V1, attempt attempt-slurp-native-stage3-rollout-r01-generation-v1) has not sealed, so scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py has not produced per_row.json / pairs.json.

entries.field_to_copy: the path itself, expressed relative to the data root, i.e. "analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLLOUT-R01-SCORE-V1/pairs.json"
entries.why_data_root_relative: core.flight.campaign.declared_readiness resolves every readiness requirement beneath the data root and refuses a path that escapes it; the baseline's advantage_pairs.relpath is the same artefact and keeps the same convention.

entries.field_to_copy: sha256 of the file's bytes (scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py writes it with write_json, LF, one trailing newline); rails.stage3_advantage.load_advantage_pairs verifies this pin at load.
the top-level "count" field (== len(pairs)); it must be <= execution_plan.planned_model_calls, which is registered at R01C's whole 625 as the ceiling.
entries.expectation: about 213 rows: the S3-3 dry run measured a 0.3398 disagreement-pair rate over 1,080 rows (docs/readiness/2026-09-22-slurp-stage3-rollout-r01-v1/s3-3-dry-run-receipt-v1.json); the engineering spec's own estimate is 300-500 of the parent R01's 800.

entries.source_artifact: docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-advantage-r01c-disagreeing-v1.json (the construction-role roster receipt scripts/flights/batch/adv1_prepare.sh writes over exactly the disagreeing rows)
entries.field_to_copy: its roster_id without the carrier prefix: "STAGE3-ADVANTAGE-R01C-DISAGREEING-V1" for roster_id "SLURP-STAGE3-ADVANTAGE-R01C-DISAGREEING-V1" (the ROLL-1 convention: split_id STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01C for roster_id SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01C).

its split_identity_hash, which is data.splits.split_identity_hash(data.splits.prefixed("slurp", <the disagreeing sample_ids>)) == sha256 of the LF-joined sorted "slurp/<sample_id>" keys, UTF-8, no trailing newline -- exactly what core.roster.verify_roster recomputes and what core.bundle.raw_contact_source cross-checks against the flown ids.
entries.hard_constraint: construction-advantage-text is a CONSTRUCTION-VISIBLE arm (contracts.CONSTRUCTION_VISIBLE_ARMS), so contracts.gate_exposure._require_construction_role_for_visible_targets refuses the model touch unless this hash is that of a COMMITTED roster_role='construction' receipt of carrier slurp under docs/receipts/rosters/. Filling this token without committing that receipt leaves a cell that fails closed at the first contact.

structural_fills.why: core.flight.repin cross-checks populations[*].ids against the recomputed split identity when a fragment inlines them (core/flight/repin.py). Cell ROLL-1 and its smoke both inline theirs; ADV-1 cannot until pairs.json names the rows. scripts/flights/batch/adv1_prepare.sh writes this block from pairs.json in the same pass that fills the tokens above.

the committed construction-role roster the exposure gate demands (see the hard_constraint above). It is a PURE SELECTION of docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-construction-r01c.json -- every surviving item is the parent's item verbatim, in the parent's order, zero contacts -- exactly as R01C is a pure selection of R01 (scripts/build_slurp_stage3_construction_clean_subset.py) and as SLURP-EVO-S1-PROPOSER-R01 is a construction sub-roster for the proposer arm. Written and verified (core.roster.verify_roster, core.roster.write_roster) by scripts/flights/batch/adv1_prepare.sh.

entries.field_to_copy: sha256 of that file's bytes, as the release-pins document scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_store.py --release-pins writes records it (the form of docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-semantic-store-release-pins-v2.json).

entries.why_a_separate_token: release.json and snapshot.json are two different files with two different digests. Until this re-pointing both were written as one PENDING_S3_5_RELEASE_SHA256 token, which no substitution tool can fill correctly; the token was split here.

structural_fills.why: core.semantic_knowledge_preparation.prepare_semantic_knowledge_store verifies authored_source, construction_scope, permitted_roster and every forbidden_rosters pin by SHA-256, and the authored document's digest only exists after the curator has written it. The committed file is therefore a TEMPLATE carrying PENDING_ pins and is never passed to the preparer; scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas.sh materialises a runnable copy under the data root with the real digests, exactly as scripts/flights/batch/r01_prep23.sh materialises configs/preparation/slurp-stage3-construction-r01-query-alias-v1.json.

entries.artifact: the decision requirement of every cell in both fragments
entries.why: Neither fragment registers a placeholder decision requirement any more. core.flight.repin._upsert_decision_requirement inserts the real one at the readiness flip (scripts/flights/repin_cell.py --set-ready) from the minted receipt under coordination/<cell>/root-admission-v1.json; a placeholder entry left beside it would carry no expected_decision_id and would refuse the campaign at load (core.flight.campaign.declared_readiness). This is the discipline the registered ROLL-1 cell states in its own readiness reason.

entries.tokens: PENDING_SLURP_NATIVE_STAGE3_DELTA_CELL[_TWIN][_SMOKE_4]_V1_OWN_<KEY>, one per cell per key (28 tokens over the four baselines)
entries.why: Item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so each of the four cells prepares its OWN supply, fit receipt and speech-feature identities under its OWN run id at the readiness flip (core.flight.cli prepare-supply through scripts/flights/repin_cell.py), never inheriting cell PLAN's even when the bytes turn out identical. These are NOT substitution-tool fills and must not be written by hand; --allow-output-change must never be passed.
